audit_title: Phase 2 Final Technical Audit & Preprocessing Verification (Refined)

1_weight_feature.investigation_dual_representation: The measurement recorded at 00:00 is present in both static descriptor (Weight_admission) and in Hour 0 of dynamic Weight time series.

justification_and_collinearity_mitigatio.sequential_models: In LSTM/CNN architectures, retaining Hour 0 weight ensures continuous time-series trajectories for tracking acute fluid accumulation.
justification_and_collinearity_mitigatio.tabular_models_xgboost: To prevent unintended duplicate weighting and multicollinearity in tree models, tabular feature extraction (Phase 3/4) must extract net delta (W_last - W_adm), fluctuation (W_max - W_min), and observation frequency rather than naive repetitive aggregations (min, max, mean, first, last) which duplicate static admission weight for 92% of patients.

2_missingness_mask_integration.finding: Deep learning architectures (LSTM, 1D-CNN) require explicit indication of observed vs imputed values to avoid false confidence on imputed signals.
2_missingness_mask_integration.correction: Generated 74-channel integrated temporal tensors (37 values + 37 observation indicators) for 48h and 24h, alongside 37-channel value-only arrays, 37-channel mask-only arrays, and 72-channel comparison tensors.

3_mechanical_ventilation.empirical_findings: 100% of recorded entries are 1.0 (procedural check). 63.1% of patients have at least one entry.
3_mechanical_ventilation.clinical_limitations: Absent records represent unrecorded status, NOT confirmed non-ventilation. In MIMIC-II ICU workflows, nurses log ventilator checks as procedural events rather than recording negative confirmations. Furthermore, extubation timestamps are unrecorded, meaning persistent ventilation until discharge cannot be verified.
3_mechanical_ventilation.standardization_exemption: MechVent is strictly excluded from continuous StandardScaler and preserved in binary {0.0, 1.0}.
3_mechanical_ventilation.no_automatic_forward_fill: MechVent is NOT forward-filled to discharge across unrecorded hours. In the hourly grid, MechVent has value 1.0 only when an explicit ventilator check was logged in that hour; unrecorded hours remain 0.0 with mask 0.0.
3_mechanical_ventilation.patient_level_indicator: Added MechVent_ever_recorded to static features (1.0 if ever recorded in the observation window, 0.0 otherwise). For 24-hour prediction, computed strictly within the first 24 hours (m <= 1440), guaranteeing zero future leakage.

4_categorical_features.finding: Treating ICUType (1=CCU, 2=CSRU, 3=MedICU, 4=SurgICU) as continuous imposed false ordinal scaling.
4_categorical_features.correction: One-Hot Encoded ICUType into 4 binary columns (ICUType_CCU, ICUType_CSRU, ICUType_MedICU, ICUType_SurgICU) with sum=1.0 per patient. Gender encoded as binary {0.0, 1.0}. Static array expanded to 9 features (3 standardized continuous + 6 binary).

5_time_boundary_validation.binning_rule: Hour 23 covers [1380, 1440] minutes (includes exactly 24:00). Hour 47 covers [2820, 2880] minutes (includes exactly 48:00).
5_time_boundary_validation.guarantees: Slicing hours 0..23 strictly guarantees zero observations after 24 hours. Hours 0..47 strictly guarantee zero observations after 48 hours. Observations > 2880 minutes are rejected as None.

6_imputation_method_b_confirmation.correction: Confirmed Method B as Historical Forward-Fill (LOCF) with Training-Set Population Median for Leading Missing Values.
6_imputation_method_b_confirmation.directionality: Strictly forward along time axis (hours 0 -> 47). Zero backward-fill from future observations (zero temporal leakage).
6_imputation_method_b_confirmation.terminology_fix: Replaced misleading term 'backfill' across all reports and code documentation with 'training-set population median imputation for leading missing values'.

7_outcome_label_provenance.set_a: Official development dataset released with published outcomes during the 2012 Challenge.
7_outcome_label_provenance.sets_b_and_c: Official test sets whose outcomes were withheld during the competition and released post-challenge by PhysioNet as academic benchmark keys.
7_outcome_label_provenance.zero_leakage_guarantee: Neither Set B nor Set C outcomes are ever accessed or used during model training, feature selection, imputer fitting, scaler fitting, or hyperparameter tuning. Used exclusively for final out-of-sample evaluation.
